title: Nathan's Hot Dog Eating Contest winning total

source.name: Nathan's Famous Hot Dog Eating Contest results
source.publisher: Major League Eating / Guinness World Records

notes: Pre-2001 record was 25 hot dogs in 12 minutes. Takeru Kobayashi more than doubled it to 50 in 2001. Joey Chestnut set the current record of 76 in 2021 (10-minute format); it has not been beaten since.
